vagas.title: Pessoa Técnica de Planejamento - MT
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Pessoa Técnica de Planejamento - MT em mato grosso do sul. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job description Na busca contínua por mentes criativas e apaixonadas por inovação, estamos à procura de indivíduos que desafiem os limites, que abracem o novo e tracem caminhos inexplorados rumo a um futuro promissor. Com 30 anos de expertise em Consultoria e Gestão de Projetos, somos uma referência nacional em Engenharia Consultiva, em constante expansão global.Com DNA de inovação, nos reinventamos eevoluímos. Nossa equipe, formada por mais de 2 mil colaboradores, trabalha para impulsionar nossa empresa rumo a um futuro ainda maisrelevante, global e digitalaté 2030.Se você se identifica com nosso propósito, vamos juntos imaginar um futuro e engenhá-lo? Main responsibilities Descrição sumária: Acompanhar e executar as atividades de planejamento, fiscalização, monitoramento das atividades relacionadas aos processos contratados, de acordo com os procedimentos internos e normas de segurança vigentes, a fim de contribuir para o cumprimento do cronograma definido. Descrição detalhada: Assegurar a execução eficiente de projetos de expansão (etanol, açúcar, cogeração de energia, biogás) ou grandes paradas de manutenção preventiva/corretiva, minimizando gargalos operacionais que afetem o ritmo da safra. Principais Responsabilidades Elaboração e Gestão de Cronogramas: Criar a Estrutura Analítica do Projeto (EAP/WBS) e gerenciar cronogramas detalhados no MS Project. Controle Físico-Financeiro: Acompanhar diariamente o avanço em campo, atualizar a Curva S (previsto x realizado) e monitorar indicadores de custo e prazo por meio de Análise de Valor Agregado (EVA). Gestão da Entresafra e Obras: Detalhar pacotes de trabalho para revisão técnica de caldeiras, moendas, dornas de fermentação, turbogeradores e frota agrícola/agronômica. Interface Multidisciplinar: Articular necessidades entre engenharia, manutenção, suprimentos e operações para garantir a disponibilidade de materiais sobressalentes e terceiros no momento correto. Relatórios e Dashboards Gerenciais: Elaborar o Relatório Diário de Obra (RDO), controlar KPIs do projeto e construir painéis de acompanhamento em Power BI para reportar desvios à liderança. Análise de Desvios e Mitigação: Mapear caminhos críticos, identificar riscos operacionais e propor planos de contingência para reverter atrasos no escopo. Requirements and skills Como requisito básico, você deve ter: Ensino Técnico completo em Mecânica ou áreas afins; Expertise em pacote office (Nível Médio); Expertise em leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos (Nível Alto); Carteira de motorista tipo B; Disponibilidade para Viajar. Você se destaca se tiver: Formação superior completo ou em andamento em Engenharia ou áreas correlatas; Gestão de projetos de obras industriais ou agrícolas; Gestão e coordenação de contratadas de obra; Instalação, ajuste e operação de válvulas e dispositivos hidráulicos especiais; Gestão da qualidade e controle de não conformidades; Rotinas de planejamento, controle e reporte de obra; Atendimento a requisitos de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente (SSMA). Additional information Características da vaga: Regime de contratação: Regular Office (Presencial) Local de atuação: Costa Rica-MT Horário de trabalho: Segunda a Quinta - de 07h até 17h; Sexta de 07h até 16h Regime contratação: CLT (temporária-4meses) Benefícios contemplados na vaga: Plano de saúde Plano Odontológico Seguro de vida Transporte Alimentação Convênio com Totalpass Descontos e parcerias com diversas instituições de ensino #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Mechanical Technical Lead
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Mechanical Technical Lead em mato grosso. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Manpower Malta is seeking to recruit a Mechanical Technical Lead to join our client's team. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership and hands-on support to the mechanical services and maintenance team, overseeing maintenance, installation, testing, commissioning, and preventive maintenance activities. The role requires strong technical knowledge, leadership capability, and the ability to coordinate resources, suppliers, subcontractors, and internal teams while maintaining high quality, safety, and operational standards. Responsibilities: Plan, coordinate, and oversee mechanical maintenance, installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance activities. Act as the main technical reference for the mechanical team, supporting complex installations, fault diagnosis, and operational issues. Coordinate manpower, resources, tools, suppliers, subcontractors, and technical documentation to ensure efficient project and maintenance delivery. Support quotations, procurement activities, cost analysis, preventive maintenance planning, and client coordination. Ensure mechanical works comply with applicable quality, Health & Safety, environmental, and company standards, including RAMS and relevant ISO requirements. Key Requirements: Technical qualification, diploma, or degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in mechanical maintenance, testing, and commissioning, with senior technical or team leadership experience preferred. Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, pumps, pipework, ventilation, rotating equipment, and associated mechanical plant. Experience with preventive maintenance planning, fault diagnosis, equipment certification, and statutory inspections. Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure and changing priorities. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para GPS Business Manager em distrito federal. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

HSBC Brazil supports large local corporations, multinational companies and institutional investors through specialist banking and financial solutions. Global Payments Solutions (GPS) provides payments, cash management and liquidity solutions to corporate and institutional clients, leveraging HSBC’s global network and capabilities. The role will support business management with strategy and core activities, such as result optimization, performance reporting and dashboards. It will contribute to process resilience and continuous improvement, helping GPS execute its priorities and surpass goals in partnership with Product, Sales, Operations and relevant functions. Key Responsibilities Manage and continuously improve key processes, ensuring clear ownership, effective governance and appropriate documentation in line with applicable policies, procedures and governance requirements. Support the identification, assessment and proactive management of operational and non-financial risks, including monitoring the effectiveness of controls, issues and actions. Support process resilience and operational efficiency by identifying vulnerabilities and improvement opportunities, in line with relevant continuity arrangements. Promote a strong risk and control culture, supporting the business in operating within the applicable risk appetite and governance framework. Support the team in providing information and coordinating responses to reviews conducted by Risk, Compliance and Audit, as appropriate. Contribute to strategic initiatives aimed at improving business performance, operational effectiveness and process resilience. Support the team in managing business performance and executing agreed priorities in support of business objectives. Support the business in analysing relevant trends, variances, risks and opportunities, translating findings into clear and actionable insights. Support the improvement of reporting and dashboards for management information, strategy execution, control and decision-making. Work in partnership with Product, Sales, Operations, Finance, Risk, Compliance and other relevant business, control and support functions to deliver agreed business priorities. Qualifications Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel (VBA, Power Query, Pivot Tables as a differentiator) and PowerPoint. Fluent Portuguese and advanced English, both written and spoken. Spanish is a plus. Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Accounting or a related field. Relevant experience in business management, controls, risk, operations, finance, consulting or banking. Experience in a global banking environment and in working with regional or global stakeholders is desirable. Ability to connect operational detail with broader business priorities and strategic objectives. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to engage effectively with senior leadership and regional and global teams. Strong analytical skills and experience working with KPIs, management information, reporting and dashboards. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description:

Manpower Malta is seeking to recruit a Project Coordinator – HVAC & Alternative Energy to join our client's team. The successful candidate will coordinate HVAC and alternative energy projects, working closely with clients, internal teams, installers, suppliers, and subcontractors. Reporting to the Department Manager, you will oversee installation activities, monitor project progress, and support the safe and timely delivery of works while maintaining quality standards and budget control. An MQF Level 4 or higher qualification in Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Renewable Energy, MEP, or a related field is preferred; relevant technical certification or training is an advantage. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Deputy Head of Compliance - Malta
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Deputy Head of Compliance - Malta em mato grosso. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

At OKX, we believe crypto will help reshape the future and contribute to greater individual freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions of customers access to crypto trading and decentralised applications. OKX is also trusted by institutions seeking secure access to crypto markets and is supported by its Proof of Reserves programme. Across our global offices, we are united by three core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These values shape how we work and help us create a collaborative, rewarding and diverse environment for every OK-er. About the Team The Compliance function is responsible for promoting a strong compliance culture and supporting the safe, sustainable growth of OKX. We are a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise the business on regulatory obligations, conduct expectations and enterprise risks. OKX Europe Limited operates within a significant EU regulatory perimeter, including authorisation as a crypto-asset service provider under the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation and as a payment institution in Malta. About the Opportunity As Deputy Head of Compliance for OKX Europe Limited, you will support the Head of Compliance in leading the entity’s Compliance function and maintaining an effective compliance framework across its crypto-asset and payment services. You will oversee the day-to-day operation of key elements of the compliance programme, provide trusted advice to senior stakeholders and deputise for the Head of Compliance when required. You will help translate regulatory requirements into practical controls and ensure that compliance considerations are embedded in products, services and strategic decisions. The position reports to the Head of Compliance, OKX Europe Limited, with appropriate access to local senior management, Board committees and relevant regional and global Compliance leaders. What You’ll Be Doing You will: Leadership & Governance: Support the Head of Compliance in managing the function, people, and annual plan, and deputise at management and committee meetings when required. Regulatory Advisory: Provide commercially aware advice to Product, Engineering, Operations, Legal, and Risk teams on EU/Maltese regulations, including MiCA, payment services, DORA, and consumer protection. Framework & Product Reviews: Maintain a risk-based framework for crypto-asset and payment activities. Conduct compliance reviews of customer journeys, disclosures, complaints, conflicts of interest, safeguarding, outsourcing, and operational resilience. Monitoring & Remediation: Run the Compliance Monitoring Programme (thematic reviews, control testing). Oversee risk assessments, escalation breaches, and drive sustainable remediation. Regulatory Relations: Assist in managing the relationship with the MFSA and other authorities, coordinating supervisory meetings, information requests, and accurate regulatory notifications/returns. Reporting: Prepare high-quality reports on key risks, trends, breaches, and monitoring findings for senior management, Boards, and committees. Cross-Functional Defense: Partner closely with the MLRO and Financial Crime teams (maintaining clear boundaries between regulatory and financial crime duties), as well as Risk and Internal Audit. Culture & Training: Coach the Compliance team, deliver targeted training to directors and staff, and champion a culture where regulatory obligations and customer interests guide business decisions. What We Look For in You Experience & Education: 5+ years of regulatory compliance experience in financial services, payments, fintech, or the crypto-asset sector, including a senior role. A bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) is required. Subject Matter Expertise: Deep working knowledge of MiCA, the EU regulatory framework for crypto-asset service providers, and EU payment-services regulation. Applied Compliance Skills: Practical experience designing and operating compliance frameworks, monitoring programmes, and risk assessments, as well as advising on tech-led product development and regulatory change. Regulator Engagement & Fitness: Proven track record of engaging with financial regulators and responding to supervisory reviews or inspections. Must possess the professional standing to satisfy regulatory fitness and propriety expectations and obtain necessary approvals. Leadership & Judgement: Strong people-management skills to set priorities and coach teams. Highly ethical and independent, with the sound judgement to constructively challenge senior stakeholders and take principled positions. Communication & Global Collaboration: Professional fluency in English with the ability to explain complex regulatory matters clearly and pragmatically. Comfortable working across functions, jurisdictions, and time zones in a fast-paced environment. Nice to Have Previous experience within a regulated crypto-asset business, payment institution, electronic-money institution or digital bank. Experience working in Malta or with the Malta Financial Services Authority. Experience supporting or deputising for a regulated Head of Compliance or approved compliance officer. Knowledge of EU regulatory requirements relating to safeguarding, stablecoins, outsourcing, operational resilience, consumer protection and cross-border passporting. A relevant professional qualification from the International Compliance Association, ACAMS or an equivalent body. A legal, accounting, risk-management or regulatory qualification. Knowledge of and genuine enthusiasm for the crypto and digital-assets industry. Learning and development programmes and an education subsidy. Team-building programmes and company events. Wellness and meal allowances. Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants. Additional benefits that we would be pleased to discuss during the recruitment process. OKX Statement OKX is committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, colour, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, non-job-related physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX 's Candidate Privacy Notice . #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Payroll & Admin Officer
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Payroll & Admin Officer em mato grosso. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

On behalf of our client, Manpower Malta is seeking to recruit a Payroll & HR Administration Officer. Our client is a well-established international organisation seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented professional to join its HR team. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in managing payroll operations, supporting HR administration processes, and ensuring smooth coordination between employees, management, and international offices. This position requires a proactive individual who can work independently while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy, confidentiality, and service delivery. Key Responsibilities Payroll Management & Coordination Manage end-to-end payroll processes, ensuring accuracy and timely execution of payroll runs. Generate payroll reports and address payroll-related queries, discrepancies, and payslip issues. Onboard new employees onto payroll systems and establish relevant leave profiles. Maintain accurate records of employee leave, including maternity, emergency, unpaid, and other designated leave categories. Calculate final settlements, outstanding leave balances, and termination payments, communicating relevant information to management. Prepare and submit year-end payroll documentation and support external audits by responding to requests and providing necessary records. Maintain payroll data integrity and ensure compliance with applicable employment legislation and company policies. HR Administration Maintain and update employee records, ensuring the accuracy of personal information, employment documentation, and banking details. Prepare employment-related documentation, including contract amendments, salary revisions, promotions, and role changes. Coordinate onboarding administration and distribute company policies and documentation to new employees. Provide guidance and support to employees and managers on HR policies, procedures, and administrative processes. Process various employee leave applications and HR requests in accordance with company policies and legal requirements. Complete statutory reporting requirements and assist with regulatory submissions where required. Support internal initiatives, audits, certifications, and organisational projects related to HR and compliance. Manage general administrative duties, including document preparation, filing, scanning, and record management. Employee Relations & Cross-Office Support Foster effective communication between HR, employees, management, and international offices. Assist in maintaining consistent HR practices and administrative procedures across multiple locations. Support employee relations matters by providing administrative assistance and first-line HR support. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth HR operations and employee experience. Contribute to wider HR projects and undertake additional duties as required. Requirements Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in payroll administration and HR administration. Strong understanding of payroll processes and employment-related administration. Knowledge of Maltese employment legislation and regulatory requirements. Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and confidentiality. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a professional and service-oriented approach. Good analytical and problem-solving abilities. Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Ability to prepare reports and interpret payroll and HR-related data. Fluency in both Maltese and English, written and spoken. Ability to work independently while contributing positively within a team environment. #LI-GB1 #J-18808-Ljbffr
